stemMd: Which finding would most directly challenge the project’s stated path?

options.label: A
options.textMd: The trees are still young during their first year

options.label: B
options.textMd: Some residents prefer benches in another colour

options.label: C
options.textMd: Crown growth persistently falls far below the forecast despite the planned care

options.label: D
options.textMd: The proposal includes a multi-year timetable

options.label: E
options.textMd: A newspaper reports the survey promptly

explanationMd: Persistent underperformance on the intermediate growth target would indicate that the route to future shade is not being achieved. That is the kind of evidence the proposed monitoring is meant to detect.

distractorRationale.a: Youth is already part of the forecast.
distractorRationale.b: Bench colour does not test shade development.
distractorRationale.d: A timetable alone is not evidence of failure.
distractorRationale.e: Reporting speed does not determine ecological progress.
